_about: Spell sprites for the stage, redrawn by ComfyUI from the concept boards in Concept/spellAnimations/ (img2img, NovaAnimeXL). Each is a quadrant of a board: tl, tr, bl or br. The render is light on black, so the sprite's alpha is its brightness and Godot draws it additively. Bolts point right (their flight turns them), so a board that drew one pointing left sets flip.
